sentences.en: From The New York Times, I'm Rachel AbraMs.
sentences.zh: 我是瑞秋·艾布拉姆斯，来自《纽约时报》。

sentences.en: This is The Daily.
sentences.zh: 这是《每日新闻》。

sentences.en: A few days ago, one of the most ubiquitous live shows in the country, Shen Yun, began its latest run at arguably its most prestigious venue, Lincoln Center.
sentences.zh: 几天前，国内最无处不在的现场演出之一——神韵，在可以说是其最负盛名的场地林肯中心开始了最新一轮演出。

sentences.en: It's drawn thousands of people to a performance that is colorful, acrobatic, and, according to many of its performers, shockingly abusive.
sentences.zh: 它吸引了数千人观看一场色彩斑斓、杂技般的表演，而据其许多表演者称，这场表演充斥着令人震惊的虐待。

sentences.en: Today, my colleague Nicole Hong on what a Times investigation has found about this secretive and sprawling enterprise.
sentences.zh: 今天，我的同事妮可·洪将为大家讲述《时报》调查所发现的关于这个神秘而庞大企业的内容。

sentences.en: It's Wednesday, April 2nd.
sentences.zh: 今天是4月2日，星期三。

sentences.en: Nicole, I have seen billboards for Shen Yun literally all over New York City.
sentences.zh: 妮可，我 literalmente（字面意思上）在纽约市的各处都看到了神韵的广告牌。

sentences.en: They are pastel-colored.
sentences.zh: 它们是粉彩色的。

sentences.en: They show people dancing.
sentences.zh: 上面有人在跳舞。

sentences.en: They're wearing this sort of long, flowy, diaphanous clothing.
sentences.zh: 他们穿着那种长长的、飘逸的、半透明的衣服。

sentences.en: But I will admit this, I don't think I've ever actually bothered to look into what these billboards were actually advertising.
sentences.zh: 但我必须承认，我以前从来没有真正费心去了解这些广告牌到底在宣传什么。

sentences.en: And now you've done this big investigation into Shen Yun, which I'm really excited to talk about.
sentences.zh: 现在你对神韵做了一项重大的调查，我真的很期待聊聊这个。

sentences.en: We're going to get to it in a minute.
sentences.zh: 我们马上就会谈到这一点。

sentences.en: But first, can you just tell us what exactly is Shen Yun?
sentences.zh: 但首先，你能告诉我们神韵到底是什么吗？

sentences.en: So on the surface, Shen Yun is this performing arts group.
sentences.zh: 所以表面上看，神韵是一个表演艺术团体。

sentences.en: They tour around the world.
sentences.zh: 他们在世界各地巡演。

sentences.en: They perform traditional Chinese dance accompanied with a full orchestra.
sentences.zh: 他们表演中国传统舞蹈，并有完整的管弦乐队伴奏。

sentences.en: And most people know them because of their advertising.
sentences.zh: 大多数人知道他们是因为他们的广告。

sentences.en: Every once in a while, something comes along so masterful, it leaves you in awe.
sentences.zh: 每隔一段时间，就会出现如此精湛的作品，让人叹为观止。

sentences.en: Their billboards are everywhere.
sentences.zh: 他们的广告牌到处都是。

sentences.en: So inspiring.
sentences.zh: 太鼓舞人心了。

sentences.en: It changes your life.
sentences.zh: 它改变了你的人生。

sentences.en: We've seen TV ads, flyers on storefronts, direct mailers into our mailboxes.
sentences.zh: 我们看过电视广告、店面的传单、塞进我们信箱的直投邮件。

sentences.en: This season, take an incredible journey through 5,000 years of culture with Shen Yun.
sentences.zh: 这个演出季，与神韵一起开启一段穿越五千年文化的不可思议之旅。

sentences.en: And they're often advertising these vague slogans.
sentences.zh: 而且他们经常宣传这些模糊的口号。

sentences.en: It's the beautiful culture and wisdom of China before communism.
sentences.zh: 这是共产主义之前的中国美丽文化与智慧。

sentences.en: Like China before communism or 5,000 years of civilization reborn.
sentences.zh: 比如共产主义之前的中国，或是重生的五千年文明。

sentences.en: See it at least once in your lifetime.
sentences.zh: 一生中至少看一次。

sentences.en: Shen Yun, an all-new production every year.
sentences.zh: 神韵，每年都是全新的制作。

sentences.en: Like many people, I have seen these for years and never thought twice about what this group was.
sentences.zh: 和许多人一样，我多年来一直看到这些广告，却从未深究过这个团体是什么。

sentences.en: They were just part of the landscape.
sentences.zh: 它们只是风景的一部分。

sentences.en: Yes, but in late 2023, my reporting partner, Michael Rothfeld,
sentences.zh: 是的，但在2023年末，我的报道搭档迈克尔·罗斯费尔德，

sentences.en: got a tip from someone who was familiar with the inner workings of Shen Yun and said we should take a closer look at their operations.
sentences.zh: 接到了一位熟悉神韵内部运作的人士的爆料，说我们应该仔细看看他们的运作情况。

sentences.en: So we started making phone calls and, of course, we also decided to go to one of their shows in Boston.
sentences.zh: 于是我们开始打电话，当然，我们也决定去波士顿看他们的演出。

sentences.en: And what was that like?
sentences.zh: 那是怎样的一种体验？

sentences.en: So the tickets were actually quite expensive.
sentences.zh: 所以门票其实挺贵的。

sentences.en: Our tickets were over $200.
sentences.zh: 我们的票花了200多美元。

sentences.en: Wow, okay.
sentences.zh: 哇，好吧。

sentences.en: It's like going to Broadway.
sentences.zh: 就像去看百老汇演出一样。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: And the show is basically a series of short, very choreographed dance and music pieces.
sentences.zh: 这场演出基本上是一系列简短、高度编排的舞蹈和音乐节目。

sentences.en: And a lot of the scenes are retelling traditional Chinese folktales and mythology.
sentences.zh: 许多场景都在重新演绎中国传统的民间故事和神话。

sentences.en: And the level of dancing is very high level.
sentences.zh: 舞蹈的水平非常高。

sentences.en: As I was watching it, it reminded me of Olympic gymnastics or ballet.
sentences.zh: 当我观看时，它让我想起了奥运体操或芭蕾舞。

sentences.en: It's a lot of flips and splits in the air, that kind of thing.
sentences.zh: 里面有很多空翻和空中劈叉之类的动作。

sentences.en: But as you get deeper into the show, you start to realize there's also something else going on,
sentences.zh: 但随着你对演出了解得更深，你会开始意识到还有另一回事在发生，

sentences.en: which is that there's a sort of spiritual and political element to some of these pieces.
sentences.zh: 那就是其中一些节目带有某种精神和政治色彩。

sentences.en: So, for example, there's this one dance number we saw where a performer is dressed as a police officer for the Chinese Communist Party.
sentences.zh: 举个例子，我们看到过这样一个舞蹈节目，一个表演者扮成中国共产党的警察。

sentences.en: And he is beating up this innocent man with a baton in a violent way.
sentences.zh: 他正用警棍暴力殴打一个无辜的男子。

sentences.en: And it turns out this man is getting beaten for practicing a religion called Falun Gong.
sentences.zh: 结果发现这个人是因为修炼一种名为法轮功的宗教而遭到殴打。

sentences.en: And it becomes clear to you as an audience member as the show progresses that the show is presenting this religion, Falun Gong, as a force for good,
sentences.zh: 随着演出进行，作为观众的你会渐渐明白，演出将法轮功这个宗教呈现为一股正义的力量，

sentences.en: fighting against the evil of the Chinese government.
sentences.zh: 在与中国政府的邪恶作斗争。

sentences.en: So that is not at all what I was expecting.
sentences.zh: 这和我预期的完全不一样。

sentences.en: I mean, I expected that you were going to tell me that it was a show with dancing and colorful costumes and being transported to faraway places.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我以为你会告诉我这是一场有舞蹈、有五颜六色服装、能带人去到遥远地方的演出。

sentences.en: But I did not expect that there would be this whole underlying religious and political message.
sentences.zh: 但我没想到会有这样一套潜在的宗教和政治信息。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: This is not just a dance group.
sentences.zh: 这不仅仅是一个舞蹈团。

sentences.en: Shen Yun is about spreading the message of this religious movement, Falun Gong, to a mainstream audience.
sentences.zh: 神韵旨在将这个宗教运动法轮功的信息传播给主流观众。

sentences.en: And I got to witness this firsthand because when I went to the Boston show, the man sitting next to me I saw at intermission was Googling on his phone, what is Falun Gong?
sentences.zh: 我对此有了切身体会，因为当我去波士顿看演出时，我看到坐在我旁边的那位男士在中场休息时正用手机谷歌搜索：什么是法轮功？

sentences.en: So that indicated to me that the message was penetrating.
sentences.zh: 这向我表明，这个信息已经渗透进去了。

sentences.en: It was coming through to this audience member.
sentences.zh: 它传达给了这位观众。

sentences.en: Which is what they want.
sentences.zh: 而这正是他们想要的。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: But at the time, we didn't fully understand the bigger picture.
sentences.zh: 但在当时，我们并没有完全理解宏观的全貌。

sentences.en: We didn't yet know what was really happening behind the scenes.
sentences.zh: 我们还不知道幕后到底发生了什么。

sentences.en: And when we dug more into Shen Yun, what we uncovered through many, many months of reporting was this massive operation built on exploitation and coercion,
sentences.zh: 当我们更深入地挖掘神韵时，我们通过许多许多个月的报道揭露的是，这是一个建立在剥削和胁迫之上的庞大运作机器，

sentences.en: all in service of Falun Gong's religious leader, who has turned Shen Yun into a major source of wealth and influence for his movement.
sentences.zh: 这一切都是为了服务于法轮功的精神领袖，他已将神韵变成了其运动财富和影响力的主要来源。

sentences.en: So tell me about this man and this religious movement.
sentences.zh: 那么，跟我讲讲这个人以及这个宗教运动吧。

sentences.en: So this religious movement, Falun Gong, began in China in the early 1990s.
sentences.zh: 这个宗教运动，即法轮功，于20世纪90年代初在中国兴起。

sentences.en: And it was started by this man whose Chinese name is Li Hongzhi.
sentences.zh: 它由一个中文名叫李洪志的人发起。

sentences.en: He was actually a grain clerk.
sentences.zh: 他其实是一名粮库统计员。

sentences.en: But somewhere along the way, he starts traveling across China to introduce this new movement he's created.
sentences.zh: 但不知在哪个环节，他开始在中国各地旅行，介绍他创立的新运动。

sentences.en: It combines elements of Buddhism with these ancient Chinese energy-based exercises that are known as Qigong.
sentences.zh: 它将佛教元素与被称为气功的中国古代能量修炼功法结合起来。

sentences.en: These are basically slow movements where you move your hands and arms around the body to circulate energy.
sentences.zh: 这些基本上是缓慢的动作，通过手部和手臂在身体周围移动来使能量循环。

sentences.en: And Li is teaching his followers his version of these exercises, along with spiritual texts that he's written.
sentences.zh: 李洪志在向他的追随者传授他版本的这些功法，以及他自己写的精神文本。

sentences.en: And he's promoting this religion not only as a way to improve your health physically, but he's also saying that this can help you reach enlightenment.
sentences.zh: 他宣传这个宗教不仅是一种改善身体健康的方式，还说这能帮助你达到开悟。

sentences.en: That this is the roadmap to becoming a better and more moral person.
sentences.zh: 这是成为一个更好、更有道德的人的路线图。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: So far, all of this sounds pretty on par with what you would expect a lot of religions to be.
sentences.zh: 到目前为止，所有这些听起来和人们对许多宗教的期望相当吻合。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: But once you get deeper into the teachings, there are more mystical elements that come up.
sentences.zh: 但一旦你更深入地了解其教义，就会出现更多神秘的元素。

sentences.en: For example, he has said that advanced practitioners can develop supernatural powers, like the ability to levitate or the ability to see through walls.
sentences.zh: 例如，他说高级修炼者可以培养出超自然能力，比如凌空漂浮的能力或透视墙壁的能力。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好吧。

sentences.en: So that seems kind of out there.
sentences.zh: 这似乎有点离谱了。

sentences.en: Are people buying into it?
sentences.zh: 人们会相信吗？

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: So it's important to understand the context of what was going on in China at the time.
sentences.zh: 所以理解当时中国背景非常重要。

sentences.en: This is the 1990s.
sentences.zh: 那是20世纪90年代。

sentences.en: It was a period of economic and political turmoil.
sentences.zh: 这是一个经济和政治动荡的时期。

sentences.en: Mao Zedong, the Communist Party leader, had died not that long ago.
sentences.zh: 共产党领袖毛泽东不久前刚刚去世。

sentences.en: And Mao had tried to stamp out traditional culture and traditional religions during his rule.
sentences.zh: 毛泽东在其统治期间曾试图根除传统文化和传统宗教。

sentences.en: So when he died, it left a spiritual vacuum in the country.
sentences.zh: 所以他去世后，在中国留下了精神真空。

sentences.en: And his death led to this revival of spiritual life in China, including ancient practices like Qigong.
sentences.zh: 他的死导致了中国精神生活的复苏，包括气功等古代修行方式。

sentences.en: So as a result, by the mid-1990s, Falun Gong has followers all over China.
sentences.zh: 因此，到20世纪90年代中期，法轮功在中国各地都有了追随者。

sentences.en: Many of them said their health did improve through the meditation exercises.
sentences.zh: 许多人说他们的健康确实通过冥想练习得到了改善。

sentences.en: And so the practice becomes extremely popular.
sentences.zh: 于是这种修行变得极为流行。

sentences.en: So very quickly, it sounds like it becomes a national movement.
sentences.zh: 所以很快，听起来它就变成了一个全国性的运动。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: And not just a national movement, but an international one.
sentences.zh: 不仅是全国性的运动，而且是国际性的。

sentences.en: Li actually started taking his lectures and his teachings to the Chinese diaspora overseas.
sentences.zh: 李洪志实际上开始把他的演讲和教义带给海外的中国海外侨民。

sentences.en: And it catches on in many countries like Australia, Canada, and the U.S.
sentences.zh: 它在澳大利亚、加拿大和美国等许多国家也流行起来。

sentences.en: as well.
sentences.zh: 也是。

sentences.en: The Chinese government has been concerned at how Falun Gong has gained adherence within the political establishment.
sentences.zh: 中国政府一直对法轮功如何在政治建制内部获得信徒感到关切。

sentences.en: But this is where it gets the attention of the Chinese Communist Party.
sentences.zh: 但正是在这里，它引起了中国共产党的注意。

sentences.en: The group claims its practitioners include as many as 100 million people in China, a figure disputed by the Chinese government.
sentences.zh: 该组织声称其在中国拥有多达1亿名修炼者，这一数字受到了中国政府的质疑。

sentences.en: Obviously, this is an authoritarian regime.
sentences.zh: 显然，这是一个威权政权。

sentences.en: They are suspicious of any group they cannot control, especially one that can mobilize large groups of people very quickly.
sentences.zh: 他们对任何无法控制的群体都心存疑虑，尤其是那些能够非常迅速地动员大量人群的群体。

sentences.en: And all of this comes to a head in April 1999.
sentences.zh: 所有这一切在1999年4月达到了顶点。

sentences.en: 10,000 people gathered in Beijing at the government leader's compound known as Jingnanhai.
sentences.zh: 1万人在北京的政府领导人住所中南海聚集。

sentences.en: More than 10,000 Falun Gong followers had this rally in Beijing.
sentences.zh: 超过1万名法轮功追随者在北京举行了这次集会。

sentences.en: It was the largest public assembly in the Chinese capital since the Tiananmen Square demonstrations a decade ago.
sentences.zh: 这是自十年前天安门广场示威活动以来，中国首都最大规模的公众集会。

sentences.en: And after the rally, this is where the persecution really starts.
sentences.zh: 集会之后，真正的迫害便开始了。

sentences.en: Today in Beijing, arrests of Falun Gong practitioners continued.
sentences.zh: 今天在北京，针对法轮功修炼者的逮捕仍在继续。

sentences.en: Police and paramilitaries have been drafted into railway stations and bus depots to prevent members of the sect traveling to Beijing to proteSt.
sentences.zh: 警察和准军事人员已被派往火车站和汽车站，以阻止该邪教成员前往北京抗议。

sentences.en: Falun Gong is banned in China.
sentences.zh: 法轮功在中国被禁。

sentences.en: China puts out an arrest warrant for Li.
sentences.zh: 中国对李洪志发出了逮捕令。

sentences.en: Meanwhile, Chinese state television is running an almost constant video campaign against the group.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，中国国家电视台正在播放几乎连轴转的反对该团体的视频宣传。

sentences.en: Newscasts have run pictures showing the group's literature and audio cassettes being crushed by a steamroller.
sentences.zh: 新闻节目播出了该团体的宣传册和磁带被蒸汽压路机碾碎的画面。

sentences.en: The leadership is now trying to discredit Falun Gong with a barrage of propaganda aimed at showing that devotion can lead to insanity, suicide or murder.
sentences.zh: 领导层现在正试图通过铺天盖地的宣传来抹黑法轮功，旨在证明盲目崇拜会导致精神失常、自杀或谋杀。

sentences.en: They start calling this group a, quote, evil cult, which the group has vehemently denied.
sentences.zh: 他们开始将这个群体称为“邪教”，该群体对此予以强烈否认。

sentences.en: The group has followers in the Communist Party and the military, and many of them have now been sent for so-called re-education in Marxist ideology.
sentences.zh: 该团体在共产党和军队中都有追随者，其中许多人现在被送去接受所谓的马克思主义意识形态“再教育”。

sentences.en: And thousands of Falun Gong practitioners are imprisoned.
sentences.zh: 成千上万的法轮功修炼者被关入监狱。

sentences.en: They are sent to labor camps.
sentences.zh: 他们被送到劳改营。

sentences.en: They are tortured.
sentences.zh: 他们遭到酷刑折磨。

sentences.en: They are beaten.
sentences.zh: 他们被殴打。

sentences.en: And some of them never make it out.
sentences.zh: 其中有些人再也没能活着出来。

sentences.en: They died in custody during long prison terMs.
sentences.zh: 他们在漫长的刑期中死于羁押。

sentences.en: It was an incredibly brutal response that led many people abroad, including lawmakers in the United States,
sentences.zh: 这是一种极其残酷的回应，导致许多海外人士，包括美国国会议员，

sentences.en: to consider Falun Gong a persecuted group and a victim of human rights abuses.
sentences.zh: 认为法轮功是一个受迫害的群体以及人权侵犯的受害者。

sentences.en: Last week, as the Chinese government stepped up its crackdown against the group, State Department spokesman James Rubin expressed concern.
sentences.zh: 上周，随着中国政府加紧对该团体的镇压，国务院发言人詹姆斯·鲁宾表达了关切。

sentences.en: We are disturbed by reports of some heavy-handed tactics being used to prevent Chinese citizens from exercising internationally protected fundamental rights and freedoMs.
sentences.zh: 我们对一些高压手段的报道感到不安，这些手段被用来阻止中国公民行使受国际保护的基本权力和自由。

sentences.en: And I think it's also important to note that this suppression continues to this day.
sentences.zh: 我认为同样重要的是要指出，这种镇压一直持续到今天。

sentences.en: This is starting to explain the scenes in the play that you described of the man who's practicing Falun Gong being beaten.
sentences.zh: 这开始解释你所描述的剧中修炼法轮功的人被殴打的场景了。

sentences.en: This is starting to make sense now.
sentences.zh: 现在这开始说得通了。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: You mentioned Lee earlier, the founder of Falun Gong.
sentences.zh: 你刚才提到了李，法轮功的创始人。

sentences.en: So where is he in the middle of all this?
sentences.zh: 那么在这场风波的中心，他又在哪里呢？

sentences.en: So by the late 1990s, in the middle of the persecution, Lee and his family have settled in the United States, in New York.
sentences.zh: 因此，到了二十世纪九十年代末，在迫害期间，李和他的家人定居在美国纽约。

sentences.en: This is now his new home base where he directs this global movement.
sentences.zh: 这里现在成了他的新大本营，他从这里指挥着这个全球性的运动。

sentences.en: And the persecution becomes this huge galvanizing and organizing force.
sentences.zh: 而这场迫害成了一种巨大的动员和组织力量。

sentences.en: And at this point, Lee's teachings actually take on an apocalyptic tone.
sentences.zh: 在这一点上，李的教义实际上带有一种末世论的调子。

sentences.en: He starts to portray the situation as this existential battle between the Chinese government and Falun Gong.
sentences.zh: 他开始将这种局势描绘成中国政府与法轮功之间的一场生死存亡之战。

sentences.en: It becomes a fight for survival.
sentences.zh: 这成了一场生存之战。

sentences.en: So in part to draw global attention to the persecution and to continue to spread the religion, Lee and his followers have this idea to put on a traveling show.
sentences.zh: 因此，为了部分地吸引全球对这场迫害的关注，并继续传播宗教，李和他的追随者萌生了一个想法，要举办一场巡回演出。

sentences.en: And that's how in 2006, Shen Yun was born.
sentences.zh: 这就是2006年神韵诞生的方式。

sentences.en: Got it.
sentences.zh: 明白了。

sentences.en: So everything you just said really helps to explain the show and the framing around, as you described it, good versus evil and Falun Gong versus the Chinese Communist Party.
sentences.zh: 所以你刚才说的所有这些，真的有助于解释这场演出以及正如你所描述的围绕正义与邪恶、法轮功与中国共产党之间的框架。

sentences.en: But given that this show is essentially propaganda, it does sort of surprise me that it's gotten so ubiquitous that it has billboards literally all over the world.
sentences.zh: 但鉴于这场演出本质上是宣传，它到处都是广告，甚至字面意义上全世界都有广告牌，这确实让我有点吃惊。

sentences.en: So how successful could the show actually be?
sentences.zh: 那么这场演出究竟能有多成功呢？

sentences.en: So this show has ended up becoming this huge moneymaker for Falun Gong.
sentences.zh: 所以这场演出最终成了法轮功的一个巨大的摇钱树。

sentences.en: We are able to look at their tax records because it's registered as a nonprofit.
sentences.zh: 我们能够查看他们的税务记录，因为它是作为非营利组织注册的。

sentences.en: And by the end of 2023, they have $266 million in assets.
sentences.zh: 到2023年底，他们拥有2.66亿美元的资产。

sentences.en: They're making tens of millions of dollars a year in ticket sales.
sentences.zh: 他们每年在门票销售上赚取数千万美元。

sentences.en: And they're stockpiling assets at a rate that would be extraordinary for any type of performing arts company.
sentences.zh: 他们以对于任何类型的表演艺术公司来说都堪称非凡的速度囤积资产。

sentences.en: Let alone this nonprofit dance group.
sentences.zh: 更不用说这个非营利舞蹈团了。

sentences.en: So how is this possible?
sentences.zh: 这怎么可能呢？

sentences.en: How are they making so much money with this show?
sentences.zh: 他们是怎么通过这场演出赚这么多钱的？

sentences.en: It's possible because Li has these legions of followers in countries all over the world who are devoted to him, devoted to this fight against the Chinese Communist Party,
sentences.zh: 之所以可能，是因为李在世界各地的国家拥有成群结队的追随者，他们忠于他，忠于这场反对中国共产党的斗争，

sentences.en: and are willing to make all of these sacrifices for him.
sentences.zh: 并且愿意为他做出所有这些牺牲。

sentences.en: But what our reporting uncovered was the extent of that sacrifice.
sentences.zh: 但我们的报道揭示的是这种牺牲的程度。

sentences.en: Because the success of Shen Yun has also come at this extraordinary coSt.
sentences.zh: 因为神韵的成功也付出了这笔巨大的代价。

sentences.en: And much of it has been at the expense of Li's most loyal followers, who have sometimes dedicated their entire lives and livelihoods to carry out his vision.
sentences.zh: 其中很大一部分是以李最忠实的追随者为代价的，他们有时将自己的整个生命和生计奉献出来以实现他的愿景。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: I'm Wynna Liu.
sentences.zh: 我是温娜·刘。

sentences.en: I write the game Connections, one of the puzzles from New York Times games.
sentences.zh: 我编写“连线”游戏，这是《纽约时报》游戏中的谜题之一。

sentences.en: And I love horror movies.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢恐怖电影。

sentences.en: I love my dog.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢我的狗。

sentences.en: And I love trying to trick you.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢试图捉弄你。

sentences.en: I'm Sam Azersky.
sentences.zh: 我是萨姆·阿泽斯基。

sentences.en: And I create the game Spelling Bee and Letterboxd on a daily basis.
sentences.zh: 我每天创作“拼字蜜蜂”和“字母箱”游戏。

sentences.en: And I have this thing called promesthesia.
sentences.zh: 我有一种叫做字色联觉的东西。

sentences.en: I see color when I'm listening to music.
sentences.zh: 当我听音乐时我能看到颜色。

sentences.en: New York Times games are made by people, like the ones you just heard from.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》游戏是由像你刚刚听到的人这样的人制作的。

sentences.en: Go to nytimes.com slash games to start playing today.
sentences.zh: 访问 nytimes.com 斜杠 games 开始今天的游戏。

sentences.en: So, Nicole, your investigation pulls back the curtain on the inner workings of this show.
sentences.zh: 妮可，你的调查拉开了这场演出内部运作的帷幕。

sentences.en: And what you found is a system that's far more complex and sounds like it exploits people in a way that might not be apparent at first blush.
sentences.zh: 你发现的是一个远比想象中复杂的系统，听起来它以一种初看可能并不明显的方式剥削着人们。

sentences.en: So, walk us through how all of this works.
sentences.zh: 那么，给我们讲讲这一切是如何运作的吧。

sentences.en: So, there are three main ways that Shen Yun is essentially built on the backs of its followers.
sentences.zh: 因此，神韵基本上建立在追随者背上的主要方式有三种。

sentences.en: One has to do with the performers in Shen Yun, the dancers and musicians.
sentences.zh: 一种与神韵的表演者有关，也就是舞蹈演员和音乐家。

sentences.en: The second has to do with the Falun Gong followers who help to finance the shows.
sentences.zh: 第二种与帮助资助演出的法轮功追随者有关。

sentences.en: And the third way involves the Falun Gong practitioners who run and operate this sophisticated media network to promote the show and also attack its critics.
sentences.zh: 第三种方式涉及那些运行和操作这个复杂的媒体网络来宣传演出并攻击其批评者的法轮功修炼者。

sentences.en: So, let's start with the first piece that you outlined, the people who are actually performing in these shows.
sentences.zh: 那么，让我们从你概述的第一部分开始，也就是真正在这些演出中表演的人。

sentences.en: How do they fit in?
sentences.zh: 他们是怎么融入进来的？

sentences.en: So, we interviewed dozens of dancers, musicians, and instructors who used to perform for Shen Yun or work for Shen Yun.
sentences.zh: 因此，我们采访了数十名曾为神韵表演或为神韵工作的舞蹈演员、音乐家和教练。

sentences.en: And what we learned was that many of the performers in Shen Yun are brought to New York when they are as young as 11 years old.
sentences.zh: 我们了解到的是，神韵的许多表演者在年仅11岁时就被带到了纽约。

sentences.en: They come from all over the world.
sentences.zh: 他们来自世界各地。

sentences.en: And they've typically grown up in Falun Gong households.
sentences.zh: 他们通常在法轮功家庭中长大。

sentences.en: This is the religion that they practiced with their parents.
sentences.zh: 这是他们与父母一起修炼的宗教。

sentences.en: And their parents were very eager to send them to Shen Yun because this dance group is seen as a holy honor for any practitioner to participate in.
sentences.zh: 他们的父母非常渴望把他们送到神韵，因为对于任何修炼者来说，参与这个舞蹈团被视为一种神圣的荣誉。

sentences.en: And the way they joined this group is that they're brought to this enormous 400-acre compound called Dragon Springs where Li himself is based.
sentences.zh: 他们加入这个团体的方式是被带到一个名为龙泉寺的庞大400英亩大院，李本人就驻扎在那里。

sentences.en: And just to illustrate how they view him there, at Dragon Springs, there is this giant golden Buddha statue.
sentences.zh: 为了说明他们在那里的看法，在龙泉寺，有一尊巨大的金色佛像。

sentences.en: The face of this Buddha looks a lot like Li.
sentences.zh: 这尊佛像的脸长得很像李。

sentences.en: Oh, wow.
sentences.zh: 哦，哇。

sentences.en: So, it sounds like he's basically made himself into, like, a godlike figure.
sentences.zh: 听起来他基本上把自己变成了一个神一般的人物。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Many Falun Gong practitioners see him as a living god.
sentences.zh: 许多法轮功修炼者视他为活神。

sentences.en: They want their kids to be close to Li.
sentences.zh: 他们希望自己的孩子能接近李。

sentences.en: And so, these young performers end up living and training at Dragon Springs, sometimes well into their 20s.
sentences.zh: 因此，这些年轻的表演者最终在龙泉寺生活和训练，有时甚至到了20多岁。

sentences.en: So, what is daily life actually like for these young students who end up living at the compound?
sentences.zh: 那么，这些最终住在园区里的年轻学生的日常生活究竟是什么样的？

sentences.en: What we found in our interviews is that it was a very grueling environment, both physically and mentally.
sentences.zh: 我们在采访中发现，这是一个在身体和精神上都非常折磨的环境。

sentences.en: Many of them described often working or training 15 hours a day, six days a week.
sentences.zh: 他们中的许多人描述经常每周工作或训练六天，每天15小时。

sentences.en: They're essentially working a professional workload as students.
sentences.zh: 他们基本上是在以学生的身份承担专业的工作量。

sentences.en: But they're getting little to no pay.
sentences.zh: 但他们几乎没有报酬。

sentences.en: We spoke to a lot of people who said they weren't paid at all during their first year on tour.
sentences.zh: 我们跟很多人谈过，他们说在巡演的第一年根本没有拿到报酬。

sentences.en: Their access to outside information is heavily controlled.
sentences.zh: 他们接触外部信息的渠道受到严密控制。

sentences.en: Some students told us they got in trouble if they were caught watching unapproved movies or listening to music that was created after the year 1900.
sentences.zh: 一些学生告诉我们，如果他们被发现看未经批准的电影或听1900年以后创作的音乐，就会惹上麻烦。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: So, you're encouraged to inform on your classmates if you see them breaking the rules.
sentences.zh: 所以，如果你看到你的同学违反规则，你会被鼓励去举报他们。

sentences.en: And then the rule breakers can actually face these public critique sessions in front of all of their peers.
sentences.zh: 然后违规者实际上可能在所有的同龄人面前面临这些公开批判会。

sentences.en: And one of the things we heard repeatedly from people is that they were discouraged from seeking medical help if they got injured.
sentences.zh: 我们从人们那里反复听到的一件事是，如果他们受伤了，他们会被劝阻不要寻求医疗帮助。

sentences.en: And this is tied to Lee's teachings.
sentences.zh: 这与李的教义有关。

sentences.en: He says that negative karma causes illness and that if you're a true believer, you can expel that from your body.
sentences.zh: 他说负面业力会导致疾病，如果你是一个真正的信徒，你可以把它从你的身体里排出去。

sentences.en: So, for example, we spoke to one dancer who said that right before a performance, she was practicing a flip and then dislocated her kneecap.
sentences.zh: 例如，我们采访了一位舞蹈演员，她说就在演出前，她正在练习一个后空翻，然后膝盖骨脱臼了。

sentences.en: One of her classmates popped it back into place and she just performed through it for two hours in completely excruciating pain.
sentences.zh: 她的一位同学把它按回了原位，然后在完全剧烈的疼痛中忍痛表演了两小时。

sentences.en: But she was terrified to ask for medical treatment and she also didn't get any because if you do, you get shamed as someone who is not a devout Falun Gong practitioner.
sentences.zh: 但她害怕要求医疗治疗，而且她也没有得到任何治疗，因为如果你这样做，你就会被羞辱为一个不是虔诚的法轮功修炼者的人。

sentences.en: There was also this former violinist in Shen Yun's orchestra who told us that he started feeling these sharp pains in his shoulder.
sentences.zh: 神韵乐团的一位前小提琴手也告诉我们，他开始感到肩膀有剧痛。

sentences.en: So, he was brought to see Lee, who touched his shoulder and then told him he was healed.
sentences.zh: 于是他被带去见李，李摸了摸他的肩膀，然后告诉他他已经痊愈了。

sentences.en: When the pain kept going, the violinist classmates told him, oh, that's because your faith is not strong enough.
sentences.zh: 当疼痛持续时，小提琴手的同学告诉他，哦，那是因为你的信仰不够坚定。

sentences.en: It wasn't until years later that he discovered the cause of the pain was actually a bulging disc in his spine.
sentences.zh: 直到多年后，他才发现疼痛的原因实际上是脊椎间盘突出。

sentences.en: And this was a consistent theme that we heard from a lot of people.
sentences.zh: 这是我们从很多人那里听到的一致主题。

sentences.en: The conditions sound so extreme.
sentences.zh: 这些条件听起来太极端了。

sentences.en: Some of the injuries that you just described, having to dance through a busted kneecap.
sentences.zh: 你刚刚描述的一些伤势，带着碎掉的膝盖骨跳舞。

sentences.en: Why do people put up with this or why do their parents let them stay?
sentences.zh: 人们为什么忍受这一点，或者为什么他们的父母让他们留下？

sentences.en: It has a lot to do with what Lee was telling the performers about their duty to Shen Yun.
sentences.zh: 这与李对表演者讲的关于他们对神韵的责任有很大关系。

sentences.en: We learned that Lee was telling them the purpose of a Shen Yun show is not only to educate audiences, but to actually save them from the end times, this end times that is coming.
sentences.zh: 我们了解到，李告诉他们，神韵演出的目的不仅是教育观众，实际上是为了把他们从末世中拯救出来，这个即将来临的末世。

sentences.en: The idea is that if audience members believe in Falun Gong's message, they'll be saved when the universe is destroyed.
sentences.zh: 这个想法是，如果观众相信法轮功的信息，当宇宙被毁灭时他们就会得救。

sentences.en: And some of the performers said they were told that any mistakes they made on stage could actually doom their audiences to hell.
sentences.zh: 一些表演者说他们被告知，他们在舞台上犯下的任何错误实际上都可能将他们的观众判处地狱。

sentences.en: So, these young people aren't just performing.
sentences.zh: 所以，这些年轻人不仅仅是在表演。

sentences.en: They actually believe they are responsible for people's salvation.
sentences.zh: 他们实际上相信自己对人们的拯救负有责任。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: One of the dancers we talked to said he had this attitude that if he did not do well as a Shen Yun performer, then the universe wouldn't be saved and it would be his fault.
sentences.zh: 我们交谈过的一位舞蹈演员说，他有这样一种态度，如果他作为神韵表演者表现不好，那么宇宙就不会得救，这将是他的错。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: So, this is the kind of pressure that a lot of these performers, many of whom are teenagers, are hearing.
sentences.zh: 所以，这就是很多这些表演者正在听到的压力，他们许多人还是青少年。

sentences.en: Another reason that many of them are terrified to leave is financial.
sentences.zh: 他们中许多人害怕离开的另一个原因是经济上的。

sentences.en: They get free tuition, free housing, free food.
sentences.zh: 他们获得免费学费、免费住房、免费食物。

sentences.en: It's a full scholarship to a boarding school, essentially.
sentences.zh: 基本上是一所寄宿学校的全额奖学金。

sentences.en: And when they try to quit, many of them are told, if you leave, you're going to have to pay all of that back.
sentences.zh: 当他们试图退出时，许多人被告知，如果你离开，你将不得不把这一切都还回去。

sentences.en: Now, we did not actually hear from anyone that they tried to seek repayment, but the threat of it was enough to keep many of them there.
sentences.zh: 现在，我们实际上并没有听到任何人说他们试图寻求偿还，但这种威胁足以将他们许多人留在那里。

sentences.en: So, basically, all of these different incentives, all of these different pressures are allowing Li to get cheap or free labor from these young people.
sentences.zh: 所以，基本上，所有这些不同的激励，所有这些不同的压力，让李能够从这些年轻人那里获得廉价或免费的劳动力。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: And that's not the only way his followers are propping up the mission.
sentences.zh: 这并不是他的追随者支持这项使命的唯一方式。

sentences.en: They're also giving large amounts of their money to Li's movement.
sentences.zh: 他们还将大量金钱交给李的运动。

sentences.en: So, the way these Shen Yun shows work, they put on hundreds of shows a year during their world tour.
sentences.zh: 因此，这些神韵演出的运作方式是，他们在世界巡演期间每年举办数百场演出。

sentences.en: And there are a lot of costs to putting on a show.
sentences.zh: 举办演出有很多成本。

sentences.en: For example, the ads, the billboards, someone has to go out and print the flyers and put them up in storefronts.
sentences.zh: 例如，广告、广告牌，必须有人出去打印传单并将其贴在店面里。

sentences.en: Someone has to pay for hotel rooms and meals for the performers.
sentences.zh: 必须有人为表演者的酒店房间和餐食付费。

sentences.en: Someone has to book the venue.
sentences.zh: 必须有人预订场地。

sentences.en: In each location, most of the costs for putting on that show are taken on by local followers of Falun Gong.
sentences.zh: 在每个地方，举办该演出的大部分成本都由当地的法轮功追随者承担。

sentences.en: So, the followers are actually putting up the money for the production costs of the show.
sentences.zh: 所以追随者实际上是在为演出的制作成本出资。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: And these are essentially unpaid volunteers who organize to put on Shen Yun shows.
sentences.zh: 这些基本上是组织举办神韵演出的无偿志愿者。

sentences.en: And if the shows do well, they get their money back, but any profit has to go back to Shen Yun.
sentences.zh: 如果演出表现好，他们会拿回钱，但任何利润都必须归还给神韵。

sentences.en: If the shows lose money, the followers are the ones responsible for making up that shortfall.
sentences.zh: 如果演出亏损，追随者就是负责弥补这一缺口的人。

sentences.en: So, they're in a very vulnerable position.
sentences.zh: 所以他们处于一个非常脆弱的地位。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: We've also obtained internal messages to Falun Gong followers that say a show in this particular city is not selling well.
sentences.zh: 我们还获得了发给法轮功追随者的内部消息，上面说某个特定城市的演出卖得不好。

sentences.en: So, you guys either need to work harder to sell tickets or you need to buy up some of them yourself.
sentences.zh: 所以你们要么需要更努力地卖票，要么你们自己需要买下一些票。

sentences.en: And Lee has publicly said that ticket sales are a sign of your spiritual devotion.
sentences.zh: 李曾公开表示，门票销售是你精神虔诚的标志。

sentences.en: So, many followers feel this urgent pressure to sell as many tickets as they can.
sentences.zh: 因此，许多追随者感到一种迫切的压力，要尽可能多地卖票。

sentences.en: And this helps explain why, in your local city, you might see so many ads for Shen Yun.
sentences.zh: 这有助于解释为什么在你们当地的城市，你可能会看到那么多神韵广告。

sentences.en: And all of this helps explain why they could be so incredibly profitable.
sentences.zh: 所有这一切都有助于解释为什么他们能如此难以置信地盈利。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: But where is the money going?
sentences.zh: 但钱都去哪儿了？

sentences.en: Like, how is it being used?
sentences.zh: 比如，它是如何被使用的？

sentences.en: So, we don't exactly know.
sentences.zh: 所以我们并不完全知道。

sentences.en: A lot of their financial records are opaque and we can't see where the money is going.
sentences.zh: 他们的很多财务记录都不透明，我们无法看到钱流向了哪里。

sentences.en: But we did uncover the story of one Falun Gong follower that could offer us a clue.
sentences.zh: 但我们确实揭露了一位法轮功追随者的故事，这可以给我们提供一个线索。

sentences.en: So, there was this woman who was Shen Yun's bookkeeper.
sentences.zh: 所以，有这么一位女士，她是神韵的簿记员。

sentences.en: She was a very, very devoted practitioner.
sentences.zh: 她是一个非常非常虔诚的修炼者。

sentences.en: Both of her kids performed with Shen Yun.
sentences.zh: 她的两个孩子都在神韵表演。

sentences.en: She spent most of her time at Dragon Springs working for Shen Yun and for the Lee family.
sentences.zh: 她把大部分时间都花在龙泉寺为神韵和李家工作。

sentences.en: And around 2018, 2019, she was getting very sick.
sentences.zh: 在2018、2019年左右，她病得很重。

sentences.en: Because she was a diligent Falun Gong believer, she resisted seeing a doctor for a long time.
sentences.zh: 因为她是一个勤奋的法轮功信徒，她很长时间拒绝去看医生。

sentences.en: When she finally did, she found out that she had kidney cancer.
sentences.zh: 当她终于去看时，她发现自己患了肾癌。

sentences.en: But she told her kids that she wouldn't be able to pay for medical treatment because she had donated all of her money to Dragon Springs.
sentences.zh: 但她告诉她的孩子们，她无力支付医疗费用，因为她把所有的钱都捐给了龙泉寺。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: And this was a huge shock to them.
sentences.zh: 这对他们来说是一个巨大的震惊。

sentences.en: Mm-hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯哼。

sentences.en: But after the bookkeeper died of cancer, a Shen Yun employee accidentally mailed the bookkeeper's credit card statement to her family.
sentences.zh: 但在这位簿记员死于癌症后，一名神韵员工不小心将簿记员的信用卡对账单寄给了她的家人。

sentences.en: What they eventually saw in the statements were tens of thousands of dollars in purchases of luxury goods from brand names like Hermes, Van Cleef, and Ferragamo.
sentences.zh: 他们最终在对账单上看到的是数万美元购买爱马仕、梵克雅宝和菲拉格慕等奢侈品牌的商品。

sentences.en: So we've heard from many former performers that Lee's wife liked to dress well.
sentences.zh: 所以我们从许多前表演者那里听说，李的妻子喜欢穿得好。

sentences.en: She liked to wear luxury brands.
sentences.zh: 她喜欢穿奢侈品牌。

sentences.en: The bookkeeper had also spent money on custom billiard queues, and we know that Lee loves to play pool.
sentences.zh: 这位簿记员还把钱花在定制台球杆上，我们知道李喜欢打台球。

sentences.en: So basically, the assessment was that these purchases were likely for the Lee family.
sentences.zh: 所以基本上，评估是这些购买很可能是为了李家人。

sentences.en: What we found was that she was spending hundreds of thousands of dollars for purchases that her family believed were for the Lee family and for Shen Yun.
sentences.zh: 我们发现她花了数十万美元购买她的家人认为是给李家和神韵的东西。

sentences.en: I see.
sentences.zh: 我明白。

sentences.en: Mm-hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯哼。

sentences.en: We also found that she was paying for the monthly cell phone bills of Lee and his wife.
sentences.zh: 我们还发现，她甚至在帮李及其妻子的每月手机账单买单。

sentences.en: And our reporting showed that some of the money was repaid to her family.
sentences.zh: 我们的报道还显示，其中的部分资金被归还给了她的家人。

sentences.en: But because it was all part of this confidentiality agreement, we don't know a lot of the details.
sentences.zh: 但由于这一切都是保密协议的一部分，我们并不了解很多细节。

sentences.en: So the purchases, the fact that she didn't seek medical treatment, the fact that she didn't have money when she did seek medical treatment,
sentences.zh: 所以这些消费、她没有寻求医疗救助的事实、她在寻求医疗救助时没有钱的事实，

sentences.en: and it seems like this bookkeeper is emblematic of how much these followers are giving to Falun Gong, whether it's their money or their labor.
sentences.zh: 而且这位记账员似乎正是这些追随者向法轮功奉献了多少钱财或劳动力的一个缩影。

sentences.en: And it also shows the extent to which this institution and maybe even the lifestyle of the Lee family is made possible by these sacrifices.
sentences.zh: 这也表明，这个机构乃至李家生活方式所依赖的程度，完全是由这些牺牲换来的。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: I also want to come back to something you said earlier because you mentioned that even beyond all of that, there's actually a third piece of this puzzle.
sentences.zh: 我还想回到你之前说过的一个话题，因为你提到，除了所有这些之外，其实还有这块拼图的第三部分。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: That is their media arm, primarily a newspaper run by Falun Gong practitioners called the Epoch Times.
sentences.zh: 那就是他们的媒体喉舌，主要是由法轮功学员运营的一份名为《大纪元时报》的报纸。

sentences.en: I've heard of it, but tell us a little bit more about it.
sentences.zh: 我听说过，不过请给我们多讲讲吧。

sentences.en: So this newspaper has been around since the persecution.
sentences.zh: 所以这家报纸在迫害发生之前就已经存在了。

sentences.en: It was initially started by Falun Gong followers in the year 2000 as a way to raise awareness about human rights abuses in China, including the persecution of Falun Gong.
sentences.zh: 它最初是由法轮功追随者于2000年创办的，旨在提高人们对中国侵犯人权行为（包括对法轮功的迫害）的认识。

sentences.en: And it specifically rose to prominence in the U.S.
sentences.zh: 它在美国真正崭露头角，

sentences.en: after the 2016 presidential election by promoting right-wing conspiracy theories and also by embracing President Donald J.
sentences.zh: 是在2016年总统大选之后，通过兜售右翼阴谋论，并拥抱唐纳德·J·

sentences.en: Trump as someone who supports the paper's opposition to the Chinese Communist Party.
sentences.zh: 特朗普总统，认为他是支持该报纸反对中国共产党立场的人。

sentences.en: And in fact, Kash Patel, who was recently confirmed as Trump's FBI director, actually had a show with the Epoch Times in recent years where he got a sit-down interview with Trump.
sentences.zh: 事实上，最近被确认为特朗普FBI局长的卡什·帕特尔，近年来也曾在《大纪元时报》有一个节目，并在其中对特朗普进行了专访。

sentences.en: But beyond their political coverage, what our investigation found was that they have also published more than 17,000 articles about Shen Yun.
sentences.zh: 但除了政治报道之外，我们的调查发现，他们还发表了超过17,000篇关于神韵的报道。

sentences.en: Oh, wow.
sentences.zh: 哦，哇。

sentences.en: And they're typically glowing audience testimonials after each show.
sentences.zh: 而且通常都是每场演出结束后热情洋溢的观众证言。

sentences.en: We found that they have this special team of reporters that go to the shows who are almost always Falun Gong followers.
sentences.zh: 我们发现他们有一支专门的记者团队去现场看演出，而且几乎全都是法轮功追随者。

sentences.en: They're often working all night, getting very little sleep, to get these reviews published as quickly as possible.
sentences.zh: 他们经常通宵工作，睡眠极少，以便尽快把这些评论发表出来。

sentences.en: And do we know how influential they've actually been, though?
sentences.zh: 不过，我们知道他们到底有多大的影响力吗？

sentences.en: So we don't exactly know how much influence this coverage has had.
sentences.zh: 所以，我们并不确切知道这些报道究竟产生了多大的影响力。

sentences.en: Like, for example, we don't know how many ticket sales can be attributed to Epoch Times coverage.
sentences.zh: 比如，我们不知道有多少门票销售可以归功于《大纪元时报》的报道。

sentences.en: But this is some pretty unusual editorial treatment for a newspaper to give to a dance show.
sentences.zh: 但对于一份报纸来说，对一个舞蹈演出给予这种程度的编辑处理是相当罕见的。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: We actually obtained internal editing guides that said anything negative about Shen Yun could not be published.
sentences.zh: 我们实际上获取了内部编辑指南，上面写着任何关于神韵的负面内容都不得发表。

sentences.en: So it seems clear that even if we can't pinpoint exactly how influential the Epoch Times is in this larger ecosystem,
sentences.zh: 因此，很显然，即便我们无法精确指出《大纪元时报》在这个更大生态系统中究竟有多大影响力，

sentences.en: it is part of this huge network that you've helped to reveal in your reporting.
sentences.zh: 它也是你在报道中帮助揭露的这个庞大网络的一部分。

sentences.en: And that network seems like at the center of it are these followers who, in many cases, have been quite mistreated.
sentences.zh: 而这个网络的核心似乎正是这些在很多情况下遭受了相当虐待的追随者。

sentences.en: I'm curious about the response to that part of your reporting about that mistreatment.
sentences.zh: 我很想知道对于你报道中关于这种虐待的那部分内容，各方有什么样的回应。

sentences.en: So, since we've published our reporting, New York state regulators have been looking into Shen Yun for their labor practices.
sentences.zh: 所以，自从我们发表报道以来，纽约州监管机构一直在调查神韵的劳工做法。

sentences.en: We also found out that there's a federal criminal investigation into Shen Yun, including into their finances.
sentences.zh: 我们还发现，联邦正在对神韵进行刑事调查，包括对其财务状况的调查。

sentences.en: And a former dancer has sued them and accused them of forced labor.
sentences.zh: 并且有一名离职舞蹈演员起诉了他们，指控他们强迫劳动。

sentences.en: And how has Li and Falun Gong responded to all of this?
sentences.zh: 那么李和法轮功对这一切是如何回应的呢？

sentences.en: They've denied wrongdoing.
sentences.zh: 他们否认有任何不当行为。

sentences.en: They say that everything they're doing is legal.
sentences.zh: 他们声称他们所做的一切都是合法的。

sentences.en: A major part of their response to our reporting is to say that our sources are Chinese spies.
sentences.zh: 他们对我们报道的主要回应之一，就是声称我们的消息来源是中国间谍。

sentences.en: They're agents of the Chinese government.
sentences.zh: 他们是中国政府的特工。

sentences.en: You know, their followers have relentlessly attacked the Times.
sentences.zh: 你知道，他们的追随者对《时报》进行了毫不留情的攻击。

sentences.en: They've attacked me personally.
sentences.zh: 他们对我进行了人身攻击。

sentences.en: Oh, wow.
sentences.zh: 哦，天哪。

sentences.en: During the course of your reporting.
sentences.zh: 在你的报道过程中。

sentences.en: Yeah, they've even published false information about my family all over the Internet, calling all of us agents of the Chinese government.
sentences.zh: 是的，他们甚至在互联网上到处发布关于我家人的虚假信息，把我们所有人都称为中国政府的特工。

sentences.en: So, this is their playbook for responding to scrutiny or criticism.
sentences.zh: 所以，这就是他们应对审查或批评的惯用套路。

sentences.en: And you can often see a lot of these responses published in the Epoch Times as news articles.
sentences.zh: 而且你经常可以看到很多这样的回应被当作新闻文章发表在《大纪元时报》上。

sentences.en: You know,
sentences.zh: 你知道的，

sentences.en: I can't help but notice that there's a certain kind of irony here that this group that flees China because of persecution comes to the United States and kind of starts acting like a persecutor just in terms of what they're doing to crack down on dissent and keep their followers in line.
sentences.zh: 我禁不住注意到这里有一种莫大的讽刺：这个因为遭受迫害而逃离中国的群体，来到美国后，竟然开始表现得像个迫害狂，仅仅因为他们在尽力打压异见并约束追随者。

sentences.en: So, that has been one of the themes that has really stuck with me throughout this reporting.
sentences.zh: 所以，这成了贯穿我整篇报道、让我挥之不去的几个主题之一。

sentences.en: It's something that's come up over and over again in our interviews with people who either personally survived the persecution in China or had family members go through it.
sentences.zh: 在我们采访那些亲身经历过中国迫害或有家人经历过迫害的人时，这个问题一次又一次地出现。

sentences.en: But they've come to the United States as refugees.
sentences.zh: 但他们作为难民来到了美国。

sentences.en: They're seeking asylum.
sentences.zh: 他们在寻求庇护。

sentences.en: They want to be able to practice their religion freely and chase the American dream here.
sentences.zh: 他们希望能够自由地信仰宗教，在这里追逐美国梦。

sentences.en: And many of them were so happy when they got into Shen Yun.
sentences.zh: 他们中的许多人加入神韵时感到非常高兴。

sentences.en: And when they got to Dragon Springs, they just felt this overwhelming sense of relief.
sentences.zh: 当他们到达龙泉寺时，他们感到如释重负。

sentences.en: So,
sentences.zh: 所以，

sentences.en: it was especially devastating once they actually saw how the group operated that this thing that they had devoted their entire lives to turned out to be something completely different.
sentences.zh: 一旦他们真正看到该团体的运作方式，就会感到格外心碎——他们倾注了毕生心血的事物，结果竟完全是另一回事。

sentences.en: Nicole, thank you so much.
sentences.zh: 妮可，非常感谢。

sentences.en: Thank you, Rachel.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你，蕾切尔。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: Tonight, I rise with the intention of getting in some good trouble.
sentences.zh: 今晚，我带着制造点“美好麻烦”的意图站在这里。

sentences.en: I rise with the intention of disrupting the normal business of the United States Senate for as long as I am physically able.
sentences.zh: 只要我体力允许，我就会站出来打扰美国参议院的正常运作。

sentences.en: I rise tonight because I believe sincerely that our country is in crisis.
sentences.zh: 我今晚站在这里，是因为我真诚地相信我们的国家正处于危机之中。

sentences.en: On Tuesday night, New Jersey Senator Cory Booker broke the record for speaking on the Senate floor, more than 25 hours without a break,
sentences.zh: 周二晚上，新泽西州参议员科里·布克打破了在参议院发言的最长时间纪录，持续了超过25个小时没有休息，

sentences.en: during which he criticized the Trump administration for violating the Constitution and disregarding the needs of everyday Americans.
sentences.zh: 期间他批评特朗普政府违反宪法并无视普通美国人的需求。

sentences.en: And so, I've tried over the last 25 hours in one minute to center the conversation back on what will we do of good conscience.
sentences.zh: 因此，在过去的25个小时里，我一直试图在一分钟内将对话重新拉回到我们如何凭良心行事上来。

sentences.en: The marathon speech beat the record set in 1957 by South Carolina Senator Strom Thurmond when he tried to block passage of a civil rights bill.
sentences.zh: 这场马拉松式的演讲打破了南卡罗来纳州参议员斯特罗姆·瑟蒙德在1957年试图阻挠民权法案通过时创下的纪录。

sentences.en: This is a moral moment.
sentences.zh: 这是一个道德攸关的时刻。

sentences.en: It's not left or right.
sentences.zh: 这不是左翼或右翼的问题。

sentences.en: It's right or wrong.
sentences.zh: 这是正确与错误的问题。

sentences.en: It's getting good trouble.
sentences.zh: 这就是去制造美好的麻烦。

sentences.en: My friend, Madam President, I yield the floor.
sentences.zh: 我的朋友，参议院议长女士，我放弃发言权。

sentences.zh: 今天的节目由斯特拉·谭制作，黛安娜·韦恩协助。

sentences.zh: 由莉兹·奥巴伦编辑，帕特里夏·威兰斯协助。

sentences.zh: 包含玛丽安·洛扎诺、丹·鲍威尔、黛安·王、帕特·麦库斯克、莉亚·肖-德梅隆和艾莉西亚·拜图普的原创音乐，由阿丽莎·莫克斯利工程制作。

sentences.zh: 我们的主题音乐由吉姆·布伦伯格和温德利的本·兰兹伯格创作。

sentences.zh: 特别感谢迈克尔·罗斯菲尔德。

sentences.zh: 这就是《今日每日秀》的全部内容。

sentences.zh: 我是蕾切尔·阿布拉姆斯。

sentences.zh: 明天见。

sentences.en: This week on The Wirecutter Show, we're getting ready for hosting over the holidays.
sentences.zh: 本周的《切割器秀》中，我们正在为假日期间的招待做好准备。

sentences.en: Tune in for tips on making your guests feel at home.
sentences.zh: 收听节目，获取让您的客宾宾至如归的小贴士。

sentences.en: Are they a blackout sleeper?
sentences.zh: 他们是需要完全黑暗才能入睡的人吗？

sentences.en: I don't mean do they blackout to go to sleep.
sentences.zh: 我不是指他们会因断片而入睡。

sentences.en: I mean what kind of light do they require because that is a very specific thing.
sentences.zh: 我是指他们需要什么样的光线，因为这是一个非常具体的问题。

sentences.en: Do they have allergies, food sensitivities?
sentences.zh: 他们有过敏症或食物敏感吗？

sentences.en: Are they coffee tea drinkers?
sentences.zh: 他们是喝咖啡还是喝茶的人？

sentences.en: What time do they like to get up?
sentences.zh: 他们喜欢几点起床？

sentences.en: Find The Wirecutter Show on the New York Times app or wherever you like to listen.
sentences.zh: 在《纽约时报》应用程序或您喜欢收听播客的任何地方查找《切割器秀》。
